feedback: This candidate builds on the previous iteration's successful design, maintaining the same geometry and sensor layout, which have proven effective. The increase of kd from 4 to 5 aims to add more damping to reduce any residual oscillations, which is supported by the earlier race data showing low but present steering oscillation (iteration 0). The base_speed is increased slightly from 1.5 to 1.6 to improve progress and completion time, leveraging the stable control observed at 1.5 speed. Changing the line_loss strategy from 'search_left' to 'search_right' tests an alternative recovery direction, which may improve line reacquisition if the previous strategy was suboptimal. Depending on the next race results, if oscillations remain or increase, consider tuning kd and kp further to balance damping and responsiveness. If line loss events increase, try reverting to 'search_left' or experimenting with 'last_direction'. If progress or completion time worsens, consider reducing base_speed slightly to regain stability.
requested_changes: controller.kp=4 (reduce proportional gain if oscillations increase)
controller.line_loss='search_left' (revert line loss recovery if events increase)
